"""Entry point: `python -m nvidia_ai [bench ...]` or `nvidia-ai [bench ...]`."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import sys

from nvidia_ai import __version__
from nvidia_ai.config import Settings


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    argv = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
    if argv and argv[0] == "bench":
        from nvidia_ai.bench import main as bench_main

        return bench_main(argv[1:])

    settings = Settings.from_env()
    logging.basicConfig(level=settings.log_level, format="%(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")

from pathlib import Path

from nvidia_ai import __version__
from nvidia_ai.__main__ import main
from nvidia_ai.config import Settings


def test_version() -> None:
    assert __version__


def test_settings_defaults(monkeypatch) -> None:
    for var in ("APP_ENV", "LOG_LEVEL", "DATA_DIR"):
        monkeypatch.delenv(var, raising=False)
    s = Settings.from_env(dotenv=None)
    assert s.env == "dev"
    assert s.log_level == "INFO"
    assert s.data_dir == Path("data")

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="nvidia-ai bench", description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--pairs", nargs="+", default=pair_labels, choices=pair_labels)
    ap.add_argument("--providers", nargs="+", default=list(PROVIDERS), choices=PROVIDERS)
    ap.add_argument("--prompts", nargs="+", default=prompt_ids, choices=prompt_ids)
    ap.add_argument("--runs", type=positive, default=3)
    ap.add_argument("--max-tokens", type=positive, default=512)
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=Path("local/benchmarks"))
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    s = Settings.from_env()
    endpoints: dict[str, Endpoint] = {}
    if "nvidia" in args.providers:
        if not s.nvidia_api_key:
            ap.error("NVIDIA_API_KEY not set (.env)")
        endpoints["nvidia"] = Endpoint("nvidia", s.nvidia_base_url, s.nvidia_api_key)
    if "ollama" in args.providers:
        endpoints["ollama"] = Endpoint("ollama", s.ollama_base_url)

    pairs = [p for p in PAIRS if p.label in args.pairs]
    prompts = [p for p in PROMPTS if p.id in args.prompts]
    with httpx.Client() as client:
        version, digests = _ollama_info(client, s.ollama_base_url)
        meta = {
            "started_utc": datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
            "machine": _machine(),
            "ollama_version": version,
            "ollama_digests": {p.ollama: digests.get(p.ollama) for p in pairs},
            "reasoning_params": "provider defaults (no reasoning_effort / think override)",
            "temperature": 0.0,
            "seed": 42,
